description.en: The instance ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or subscribe instance.

description.zh:
迁移、同步或订阅任务ID。

> 可调用[DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~)接口获取任务ID。
description.en:
The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task.

> You can call the [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) operation to query the task ID.

description.zh: DTS实例所在地域，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh:
同步方向，取值：

- **Forward**：正向。
- **Reverse**：反向。

> - 默认取值为**Forward**。
- 当数据同步实例的拓扑为双向时，才可以传入**Reverse**以暂停反向同步链路。
description.en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:

- **Forward**: forward.
- **Reverse**: reverse.

> - Default value: **Forward**.
- You can set this parameter to **Reverse** to suspend the reverse synchronization link only if the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization.

description.zh:
是否无感集成（Zero-ETL）任务，取值：

- **false**：否。
- **true**：是。
description.en:
Specifies whether the node is a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) node. Valid values:

- **false**: no.
- **true**: yes.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts suspend-dts-job --dts-job-id l3m1213ye7l0000 --dts-instance-id dtsl3m1213ye7l0000 --synchronization-direction Forward --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zero-etl-job true --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts SuspendDtsJob --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId l3m1213ye7l0000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --ZeroEtlJob true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DtsInstanceId dtsl3m1213ye7l0000 --SynchronizationDirection Forward
